notes: REF-BM-03: title/description editable only after save (editInline); save flow auto-creates the bookmark immediately, no pre-save edit step. REF-BM-04: store.update whitelists title/description/note/tags/flags but NOT url, so url cannot be edited. REF-BM-14: search is plain substring; no #tag syntax parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised-group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-20: bulk supports add-tag/archive/delete only; no remove-tags or read/unread bulk actions. REF-BM-21: bulk acts only on manually checked ids; no 'apply to whole filtered collection' affordance. REF-BM-23: markdown note can be written but is rendered via textContent as plain text, not rendered markdown. REF-BM-24: no snapshot/PDF functionality. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (font size, displayed items, persisted default sort); sort select is transient only.
